remarks: Experience the pinnacle of city living in this exquisite two-bedroom condo, where contemporary elegance meets urban convenience in the heart of downtown Stamford. Thoughtfully reimagined with a modern industrial aesthetic, this stunning residence is nestled in a distinguished concierge building, offering an unparalleled blend of luxury and lifestyle. Step inside to discover an open-concept layout designed for effortless entertaining, accentuated by sleek recessed lighting, high-end finishes, and expansive windows that flood the space with natural light. The seamless flow leads to a private balcony, where unobstructed panoramic views of the sunset create the perfect backdrop for relaxing evenings. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring top-of-the-line appliances, a convenient pantry, and stylish finishes that elevate every culinary experience. Retreat to the luxurious primary suite, complete with a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-inspired ensuite bath, where designer fixtures and premium materials exude tranquility. Enjoy an array of exclusive amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, a stylish community lounge, private storage lockers, and a covered garage parking space. Plus, with heating and cooling included in the HOA, year-round comfort is effortless. This prime location places public transportation just steps from your door, with Stamford's finest dining, shopping, and entertainment all within easy reach. Don't miss this rare opportunity!
